TEST PERFORMED
Karyotype Analysis - Follow-up to Rapid PCR

CLINICAL INDICATION
Follow-up karyotype analysis as per protocol following rapid aneuploidy PCR screening performed on [redacted date].

METHODOLOGY
G-banded chromosome analysis was performed on cultured peripheral blood lymphocytes. Twenty metaphase cells were analyzed at a resolution of 450-550 bands. This analysis follows the initial rapid PCR testing for common aneuploidies (chromosomes 13, 18, 21, X, and Y) previously reported.

RESULTS
Karyotype: 46,XX

Normal female karyotype. No numerical or structural chromosome abnormalities detected at the resolution of this analysis.

INTERPRETATION
This G-banded karyotype analysis confirms the normal female result obtained by rapid PCR testing. No additional chromosome abnormalities were identified.

LIMITATIONS
This analysis cannot detect abnormalities smaller than the resolution of the banding pattern (approximately 5-10 Mb), low-level mosaicism (<20%), or balanced rearrangements that do not result in visible changes to the banding pattern.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director: [redacted name], MD, PhD
